author: Bill Ferguson
name: image_time
description: Non-destructively adjusts, sets, synchronizes, or resets the recorded capture time of images by modifying the database datetime field.
description-extensive: This tool lets you fix or change the date and time recorded on your photos without altering the original files. It is especially handy when you shoot with two cameras whose clocks were not in sync, or when adding dates to scanned images that have none, letting you line everything up so photos sort correctly by time. No extra software is needed.
